Retry an Entrez call across transient failures

with_entrez_retry.Rd

Entrez fails transiently often enough that a single attempt is not a reliable read: DNS resolution times out, the load balancer returns 502 on large batches, and rentrez occasionally throws "subscript out of bounds" parsing a truncated response. Every one of those is retryable, and every one of them silently cost this pipeline a whole batch of species before this helper existed – the 2026-08-19 run lost all 24 Quebec amphibians to a single 10-second DNS timeout on query 1 of 954.

Usage

with_entrez_retry(
  expr,
  max_attempts = 4,
  sleep_fn = Sys.sleep,
  label = "entrez call"
)

Arguments

expr

Quoted expression performing the Entrez call

max_attempts

Integer, total attempts before giving up, default 4

sleep_fn

Function with signature (seconds), default Sys.sleep(); injectable so retry backoff doesn't slow down tests

label

Character, short description used in log messages

Value

The value of expr, or a condition object if every attempt failed
